text:
erin: Heads up, my router decided to take an unplanned nap during a client call — turned out I had moved it to the laundry room? Posted a pic of my temporary kitchen setup: https://files.slack.com/archives/random/FIMG1234/KITCHEN1.jpg

vik: haha laundry room routers are peak misplacement. Try moving it up and away from appliances, even a small table works.

samir: Also check for channel overlap in the apartment building. If everyone's on channel 6 2.4GHz, you get weird packet loss. Use 1, 6, or 11.

erin: How do I check channel quickly on mac/windows?

julia: Mac: Option+click wifi icon -> it shows channel. Windows: netsh wlan show networks mode=bssid in cmd. Or use a phone WiFi analyzer app.

ops-bot: Tip: "If moving router isn't an option, try temporarily tethering to your phone as a hotspot or plug into ethernet adapter. For immediate audio stability, disable camera and lower Zoom resolution." :robot_face:

erin: Thanks! Also my neighbor's sheepdog apparently thinks my window is a suggestion and barked through the whole call. Any cheap noise fixes?

vik: White noise machine near the window helps. Also a folded blanket or moving mic further from the window reduces pickup.

samir: If you're using a headset, set mic to uni-directional cardioid if available. Software noise suppression (Krisp/Zoom high) helps too.

erin: Did blanket + hotspot + headset and survived the rest of the meeting. Posting before/after pic later if anyone's bored. :sweat_smile:

julia: Please post. Bonus points if the sheepdog approves. :dog:
